assets.name: Crate stacks (kitbash of Poly Haven Wooden Crate 02)
assets.notes: 2- and 3-high stacks of wooden_crate_02 (1K glTF), each crate decimated to ~325 triangles and stretched to a 0.53 m layer, joined into one mesh by tools/props/kitbash.py. Textures are the model's 1K diffuse, nor_gl and arm via texpack

assets.name: Sandbag courses (kitbash of Poly Haven Cement Bag)
assets.notes: 3- and 5-course walls of cement_bag (1K glTF) decimated to ~165 triangles a bag and joined into one mesh by tools/props/kitbash.py. The sack's branded texture is dropped: its UVs are rebuilt as box-projected burlap and it wears materials/hessian_230 (Poly Haven, CC0), tinted khaki

assets.name: Poly Haven Belfast Sunset (Pure Sky)
assets.notes: 2K HDR as a 512px BC6H cubemap, turned 115.7 degrees, via texpack --sky; diffuse.ktx2 and specular.ktx2 are its prefiltered irradiance and GGX chain, from the same run

assets.name: Evening Road 01 (Pure Sky)
assets.notes: 2K HDR as a 512px BC6H cubemap, turned -71.6 degrees, via texpack --sky

assets.name: Poly Haven Kloofendal Overcast (Pure Sky)
assets.notes: 2K HDR as a 512px BC6H cubemap, turned 184.3 degrees to put its sun at the Quarry's, via texpack --sky; diffuse.ktx2 and specular.ktx2 are its prefiltered irradiance and GGX chain

assets.name: Poly Haven Overcast Soil (Pure Sky)
assets.notes: 2K HDR as a 512px BC6H cubemap, unrotated, via texpack --sky; diffuse.ktx2 and specular.ktx2 are its prefiltered irradiance and GGX chain, from the same run

assets.name: Poly Haven Qwantani Night (Pure Sky)
assets.notes: 2K HDR as a 512px BC6H cubemap via texpack --sky ; diffuse.ktx2 and specular.ktx2 are its prefiltered irradiance and GGX chain from the same run (the Village's sky lights its streets; the Dam's lights nothing)
